create_Internlm2ToolParser: create an Internlm2ToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tools list for parsing tool calls
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a model output string containing <|action_start|><|plugin|> delimiters
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract streaming tool calls from incremental text deltas using partial JSON parsing
adjust_request: adjust a chat completion or responses request to preserve special tokens for tool call parsing
get_arguments: get arguments or parameters from a tool call object supporting both key names
